angle: It works cost-complexity pruning end to end by hand, computing SSR totals and alpha-penalized tree scores for every subtree of one dosage tree before selecting alpha by cross-validation.
angle_detail: Watch the SSR arithmetic first at [04:11] through [07:54], then the tree-score comparison at [07:54] to [10:48] where the penalty flips the winner. Finish with the alpha sweep and cross-validation selection at [13:06] to [15:44]. It assumes regression trees and cross-validation throughout, and the alpha equals 10000 arithmetic is example-specific rather than a rule, so do not memorize the winning subtree.
